note: Khalkhali's introductory text. Examples 2.1.5 and 2.5.9 compute the irrational Kronecker foliation's transverse groupoid $\mathbb{T}\rtimes_\theta\mathbb{Z}$ and identify its algebra with the noncommutative torus $A_\theta$.

title: Perfectoid Spaces
note: Perfectoid Spaces. Introduces perfectoid fields and perfectoid spaces, proves the tilting equivalence between perfectoid spaces over $K$ and over its tilt $K^\flat$ in characteristic $p$, and deduces the weight-monodromy conjecture for complete intersections.

title: p-Adic Hodge Theory for Rigid-Analytic Varieties
note: p-Adic Hodge Theory for Rigid-Analytic Varieties. Develops the pro-étale site and the period sheaves $\mathbb{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^+$ on rigid-analytic varieties, proving the de Rham comparison and degeneration of the Hodge–de Rham spectral sequence for proper smooth rigid spaces.

title: Étale Cohomology of Diamonds
note: Étale Cohomology of Diamonds. Defines diamonds as quotients of perfectoid spaces by pro-étale equivalence relations and builds the six-functor formalism for étale cohomology of diamonds and small v-stacks.

title: Integral p-Adic Hodge Theory
note: Integral p-Adic Hodge Theory. Constructs the $A_{\mathrm{inf}}$-cohomology of proper smooth formal schemes over $\mathcal{O}_C$ interpolating étale, crystalline and de Rham cohomology, and bounds torsion in étale cohomology by torsion in de Rham cohomology.

title: Topological Hochschild Homology and Integral p-Adic Hodge Theory
note: Topological Hochschild Homology and Integral p-Adic Hodge Theory. Recovers $A_{\mathrm{inf}}$-cohomology and crystalline cohomology from topological Hochschild and topological cyclic homology via the motivic filtration on $\mathrm{THH}$, $\mathrm{TC}^-$ and $\mathrm{TP}$ of quasisyntomic rings.

title: Absolute Prismatic Cohomology
note: Absolute Prismatic Cohomology. Studies the absolute prismatic cohomology of $p$-adic formal schemes via the Cartier–Witt stack $\mathrm{WCart}$, proving comparisons with syntomic cohomology and constructing prismatic F-gauges.

title: The Prismatization of p-Adic Formal Schemes
note: The Prismatization of p-Adic Formal Schemes. Constructs the prismatization $X^{\Delta}$ of a bounded $p$-adic formal scheme as a stack over $\mathrm{WCart}$ whose quasi-coherent cohomology recovers absolute prismatic cohomology.

title: Prismatization
note: Prismatization. Geometrizes prismatic cohomology through the stacks $\Sigma$, $\Sigma'$ and $\Sigma''$ built from Witt vectors, describing the Hodge–Tate divisor and the Breuil–Kisin twists stack-theoretically.

title: The Pro-Étale Topology for Schemes
note: The Pro-Étale Topology for Schemes. Defines the pro-étale site of a scheme, shows it is locally weakly contractible and replete, and uses it to give a clean definition of $\ell$-adic sheaves and the constructible derived category.

title: The arc-Topology
note: The arc-Topology. Introduces the arc-topology on qcqs schemes, detected by rank-one valuation rings, and proves arc-descent for étale cohomology with torsion coefficients and for perfect schemes.

title: Relative p-Adic Hodge Theory: Foundations
note: Relative p-Adic Hodge Theory: Foundations. Develops relative $(\varphi, \Gamma)$-modules over adic spaces, perfectoid algebras and the correspondence between étale local systems and $\varphi$-modules over relative Robba rings.

title: An Introduction to the Theory of p-Adic Representations
note: An Introduction to the Theory of p-Adic Representations. Survey of Fontaine's rings $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{cris}}, \mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{st}}, \mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}$, $(\varphi, \Gamma)$-modules, and the proof that de Rham representations are potentially semistable.

title: Prismatic Dieudonné Theory
note: Prismatic Dieudonné Theory. Classifies $p$-divisible groups over quasi-syntomic rings by admissible prismatic Dieudonné crystals, generalizing crystalline Dieudonné theory.

title: Foundations for Almost Ring Theory
note: Foundations for Almost Ring Theory. Systematic treatment of almost mathematics: almost modules, almost algebras, almost étale extensions and descent, as used in Faltings' approach to $p$-adic Hodge theory.

title: Algebraization and Tannaka Duality
note: Algebraization and Tannaka Duality. Proves that for affine $X$, maps $\operatorname{Spf} A \to X$ from complete noetherian rings algebraize, via a Tannaka duality for perfect complexes on qcqs schemes.

title: Proof of the Geometric Langlands Conjecture I: Construction of the Functor
note: Proof of the Geometric Langlands Conjecture I: Construction of the Functor. Constructs the geometric Langlands functor from the automorphic category $\mathrm{D\text{-}mod}_{\frac12}(\mathrm{Bun}_G)$ to $\mathrm{IndCoh}_{\mathrm{Nilp}}(\mathrm{LocSys}_{\check G})$ and shows the de Rham, Betti, restricted and tempered forms of the conjecture are equivalent.

title: Periods and Harmonic Analysis on Spherical Varieties
note: Periods and Harmonic Analysis on Spherical Varieties. Develops Plancherel formulas for spherical varieties $X = H \backslash G$ over local fields and formulates conjectures relating global $H$-periods to special values of L-functions determined by the dual group $\check G_X$.

title: Symplectic Local Root Numbers, Central Critical L-Values, and Restriction Problems
note: Symplectic Local Root Numbers, Central Critical L-Values, and Restriction Problems. States the Gan–Gross–Prasad conjectures on branching laws for classical groups in terms of symplectic root numbers of Langlands parameters, and their global analogue relating period integrals to central L-values.

title: Le Lemme Fondamental pour les Algèbres de Lie
note: Le Lemme Fondamental pour les Algèbres de Lie. Proves the fundamental lemma of Langlands–Shelstad using the cohomology of the Hitchin fibration, perverse sheaves, the decomposition theorem and a support theorem for abelian fibrations.

title: Chtoucas pour les Groupes Réductifs et Paramétrisation de Langlands Globale
note: Chtoucas pour les Groupes Réductifs et Paramétrisation de Langlands Globale. Constructs the automorphic-to-Galois direction of global Langlands for any reductive group over a function field using excursion operators on the cohomology of moduli of shtukas.

title: The Conjectural Connections Between Automorphic Representations and Galois Representations
note: The Conjectural Connections Between Automorphic Representations and Galois Representations. Formulates $C$-algebraic and $L$-algebraic automorphic representations and states precise conjectures attaching Galois representations valued in the C-group to algebraic automorphic representations.

title: Modularity Lifting Beyond the Taylor–Wiles Method
note: Modularity Lifting Beyond the Taylor–Wiles Method. Extends Taylor–Wiles patching to settings where the defect $\ell_0 > 0$, proving minimal modularity lifting for weight-one forms and, conditionally, for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over CM fields.

title: Potential Automorphy over CM Fields
note: Potential Automorphy over CM Fields. Proves potential automorphy of elliptic curves over CM fields and the Ramanujan conjecture on average via local-global compatibility for torsion classes and a new Taylor–Wiles patching argument.

title: On the Rigid Cohomology of Certain Shimura Varieties
note: On the Rigid Cohomology of Certain Shimura Varieties. Constructs Galois representations for regular algebraic cuspidal automorphic representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over CM fields via $p$-adic interpolation on unitary Shimura varieties.

title: An Introduction to Affine Grassmannians and the Geometric Satake Equivalence
note: An Introduction to Affine Grassmannians and the Geometric Satake Equivalence. Lecture notes on affine Grassmannians, their Schubert varieties, the convolution product and the geometric Satake equivalence $\mathrm{Perv}_{L^+G}(\mathrm{Gr}_G) \simeq \mathrm{Rep}(\check G)$, including mixed-characteristic versions.

title: Geometric Langlands Duality and Representations of Algebraic Groups over Commutative Rings
note: Geometric Langlands Duality and Representations of Algebraic Groups over Commutative Rings. Proves the geometric Satake equivalence with integral coefficients, identifying $L^+G$-equivariant perverse sheaves on the affine Grassmannian with representations of the dual group scheme over any commutative ring.

title: Electric-Magnetic Duality and the Geometric Langlands Program
note: Electric-Magnetic Duality and the Geometric Langlands Program. Derives geometric Langlands from S-duality of topologically twisted $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang–Mills theory compactified on a Riemann surface, with 't Hooft operators acting as Hecke operators on branes in the Hitchin moduli space.

title: Singular Support of Coherent Sheaves and the Geometric Langlands Conjecture
note: Singular Support of Coherent Sheaves and the Geometric Langlands Conjecture. Introduces singular support for ind-coherent sheaves on quasi-smooth derived stacks and uses it to formulate the corrected geometric Langlands conjecture with nilpotent singular support.

title: On Some Finiteness Questions for Algebraic Stacks
note: On Some Finiteness Questions for Algebraic Stacks. Proves compact generation of $\mathrm{QCoh}$ and D-modules on QCA stacks, and that $\mathrm{D\text{-}mod}(\mathrm{Bun}_G)$ is compactly generated via truncatable open substacks.

title: The Motivic Fundamental Group of $\mathbb{P}^1 \setminus \{0,1,\infty\}$ and the Theorem of Siegel
note: The Motivic Fundamental Group of $\mathbb{P}^1 \setminus \{0,1,\infty\}$ and the Theorem of Siegel. Introduces unipotent Selmer varieties and a non-abelian Chabauty method, reproving Siegel's finiteness of integral points on $\mathbb{P}^1 \setminus \{0,1,\infty\}$.

title: The Unipotent Albanese Map and Selmer Varieties for Curves
note: The Unipotent Albanese Map and Selmer Varieties for Curves. Develops the unipotent Albanese map from a curve to its Selmer varieties and gives conditions under which Chabauty–Kim proves finiteness of rational points.

title: Explicit Chabauty–Kim for the Split Cartan Modular Curve of Level 13
note: Explicit Chabauty–Kim for the Split Cartan Modular Curve of Level 13. Uses quadratic Chabauty to determine the rational points of the genus-3 modular curve $X_s(13)$, completing the classification of split Cartan images mod 13.

title: Diophantine Problems and p-Adic Period Mappings
note: Diophantine Problems and p-Adic Period Mappings. Proves finiteness of $S$-integral points on hypersurfaces and reproves Mordell's conjecture using big monodromy of variations of Hodge structure and $p$-adic period maps.

title: Binary Quartic Forms Having Bounded Invariants, and the Boundedness of the Average Rank of Elliptic Curves
note: Binary Quartic Forms Having Bounded Invariants, and the Boundedness of the Average Rank of Elliptic Curves. Counts $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$-orbits of binary quartic forms to show the average size of the 2-Selmer group of elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ is 3, bounding the average rank by 1.5.

title: Ternary Cubic Forms Having Bounded Invariants, and the Existence of a Positive Proportion of Elliptic Curves Having Rank 0
note: Ternary Cubic Forms Having Bounded Invariants, and the Existence of a Positive Proportion of Elliptic Curves Having Rank 0. Computes the average size of 3-Selmer groups as 4 and deduces that the average rank is below 1.17 and a positive proportion of elliptic curves have rank 0.

title: Random Maximal Isotropic Subspaces and Selmer Groups
note: Random Maximal Isotropic Subspaces and Selmer Groups. Models $p$-Selmer groups as intersections of random maximal isotropic subspaces in a quadratic space, predicting the distribution of Selmer ranks.

title: Modeling the Distribution of Ranks, Selmer Groups, and Shafarevich–Tate Groups of Elliptic Curves
note: Modeling the Distribution of Ranks, Selmer Groups, and Shafarevich–Tate Groups of Elliptic Curves. Models Selmer and Shafarevich–Tate groups by cokernels of random alternating matrices, giving a unified heuristic consistent with Cohen–Lenstra and Poonen–Rains.

title: Homological Stability for Hurwitz Spaces and the Cohen–Lenstra Conjecture over Function Fields
note: Homological Stability for Hurwitz Spaces and the Cohen–Lenstra Conjecture over Function Fields. Proves homological stability for Hurwitz spaces of branched covers and deduces the Cohen–Lenstra heuristics for $\mathbb{F}_q(t)$ in the large-$q$ limit.

title: The André–Oort Conjecture for $\mathcal{A}_g$
note: The André–Oort Conjecture for $\mathcal{A}_g$. Completes the proof of André–Oort for the moduli of principally polarized abelian varieties by combining the averaged Colmez conjecture with the Pila–Zannier o-minimal strategy.

title: Tame Topology of Arithmetic Quotients and Algebraicity of Hodge Loci
note: Tame Topology of Arithmetic Quotients and Algebraicity of Hodge Loci. Shows period maps are definable in $\mathbb{R}_{\mathrm{an,exp}}$ and gives an o-minimal proof of the Cattani–Deligne–Kaplan algebraicity of Hodge loci.

title: o-Minimal GAGA and a Conjecture of Griffiths
note: o-Minimal GAGA and a Conjecture of Griffiths. Proves a GAGA theorem for definable analytic spaces and deduces that images of period maps are quasi-projective algebraic varieties.

title: Geometry of the Scaling Site
note: Geometry of the Scaling Site. Studies the scaling site obtained from the arithmetic site by extension of scalars, its points as a tropical curve-like space and the Riemann–Roch problem for its periodic orbits.

title: Trace Formula in Noncommutative Geometry and the Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
note: Trace Formula in Noncommutative Geometry and the Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function. Proposes a spectral realization of the zeros of the zeta function via the action of the idele class group on the adèle class space, reducing RH to a trace formula (the Weil positivity).

title: From Physics to Number Theory via Noncommutative Geometry
note: From Physics to Number Theory via Noncommutative Geometry. Survey of quantum statistical mechanics of $\mathbb{Q}$-lattices, the Bost–Connes and GL$_2$ systems, KMS states and their arithmetic symmetries.

title: An Essay on the Riemann Hypothesis
note: An Essay on the Riemann Hypothesis. Surveys approaches to RH through Weil's proof over function fields, the adèle class space, the arithmetic site and the search for a geometry underlying the explicit formulas.

title: Weil Positivity and Trace Formula, the Archimedean Place
note: Weil Positivity and Trace Formula, the Archimedean Place. Proves Weil positivity for test functions supported in a small interval at the archimedean place, using prolate spheroidal wave functions and the semilocal trace formula.

title: The Primes Contain Arbitrarily Long Arithmetic Progressions
note: The Primes Contain Arbitrarily Long Arithmetic Progressions. Proves the Green–Tao theorem through a transference principle: a relative Szemerédi theorem for pseudorandom majorants applied to the Goldston–Yıldırım weights.

title: Small Gaps Between Primes
note: Small Gaps Between Primes. Introduces multidimensional Selberg sieve weights, showing $\liminf (p_{n+m} - p_n) \ll m^3 e^{4m}$ and bounded gaps at most 600.

title: New Large Value Estimates for Dirichlet Polynomials
note: New Large Value Estimates for Dirichlet Polynomials. Improves Ingham's zero-density estimate to $N(\sigma, T) \le T^{30(1-\sigma)/13 + o(1)}$ by bounding large values of Dirichlet polynomials near $N^{3/4}$, with applications to primes in short intervals.

title: Moments of the Riemann Zeta Function
note: Moments of the Riemann Zeta Function. Proves on RH the almost sharp upper bound $\int_0^T |\zeta(\tfrac12 + it)|^{2k} dt \ll T (\log T)^{k^2 + \varepsilon}$.

title: Sharp Conditional Bounds for Moments of the Riemann Zeta Function
note: Sharp Conditional Bounds for Moments of the Riemann Zeta Function. Removes the $\varepsilon$ in Soundararajan's bound, proving on RH the sharp order $T (\log T)^{k^2}$ for all moments.

title: Proof of the Main Conjecture in Vinogradov's Mean Value Theorem for Degrees Higher Than Three
note: Proof of the Main Conjecture in Vinogradov's Mean Value Theorem for Degrees Higher Than Three. Proves the Vinogradov main conjecture via $\ell^2$ decoupling for the moment curve, a harmonic-analysis approach to exponential sums.

title: The Proof of the $\ell^2$ Decoupling Conjecture
note: The Proof of the $\ell^2$ Decoupling Conjecture. Proves sharp $\ell^2$ decoupling for compact hypersurfaces with positive definite second fundamental form, with applications to Strichartz estimates and lattice point counting.

title: A Restriction Estimate Using Polynomial Partitioning
note: A Restriction Estimate Using Polynomial Partitioning. Proves new Fourier restriction estimates in $\mathbb{R}^3$ via polynomial partitioning, controlling wave packets concentrated near algebraic surfaces.

title: Strong Bounds for 3-Progressions
note: Strong Bounds for 3-Progressions. Shows subsets of $\{1, \dots, N\}$ free of 3-term progressions have density $\exp(-c (\log N)^{1/12})$, using almost-periodicity and a new density-increment on spectral sets.

title: Breaking the Logarithmic Barrier in Roth's Theorem on Arithmetic Progressions
note: Breaking the Logarithmic Barrier in Roth's Theorem on Arithmetic Progressions. Improves Roth's theorem to density $(\log N)^{-1-c}$, answering an Erdős conjecture for 3-term progressions.

title: On a Conjecture of Marton
note: On a Conjecture of Marton. Proves the polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa conjecture over $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ using an entropic formulation and the entropic Ruzsa distance.

title: Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma Revisited
note: Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma Revisited. Recasts the regularity lemma as an energy-increment argument in probability spaces, yielding the removal lemma and a proof of Roth's theorem.

title: Structure and Randomness in Combinatorics
note: Structure and Randomness in Combinatorics. FOCS tutorial on the dichotomy between structure and pseudorandomness via regularity lemmas, Gowers norms and the transference principle.

title: The Dichotomy Between Structure and Randomness, Arithmetic Progressions, and the Primes
note: The Dichotomy Between Structure and Randomness, Arithmetic Progressions, and the Primes. ICM lecture explaining how structure theorems decomposing objects into structured and pseudorandom parts underlie Szemerédi's theorem and Green–Tao.

title: Convergent Sequences of Dense Graphs I: Subgraph Frequencies, Metric Properties and Testing
note: Convergent Sequences of Dense Graphs I: Subgraph Frequencies, Metric Properties and Testing. Proves equivalence of left convergence and convergence in cut distance, and applies it to property testing.

title: Recent Developments in Graph Ramsey Theory
note: Recent Developments in Graph Ramsey Theory. Survey of Ramsey numbers of graphs and hypergraphs, including sparse graphs, induced Ramsey, and Erdős–Hajnal.

title: An Exponential Improvement for Diagonal Ramsey
note: An Exponential Improvement for Diagonal Ramsey. Proves $R(k) \le (4 - \varepsilon)^k$ with a book-algorithm that finds large red books or blue cliques.

title: A Proof of the Kahn–Kalai Conjecture
note: A Proof of the Kahn–Kalai Conjecture. Shows the threshold of any monotone property is within a logarithmic factor of its expectation threshold.

title: Improved Bounds for the Sunflower Lemma
note: Improved Bounds for the Sunflower Lemma. Improves the Erdős–Rado sunflower bound to $(\log k \cdot \log\log k)^{k}$ via spread families and the robust sunflower lemma.

title: Milnor Numbers of Projective Hypersurfaces and the Chromatic Polynomial of Graphs
note: Milnor Numbers of Projective Hypersurfaces and the Chromatic Polynomial of Graphs. Proves log-concavity of the coefficients of the chromatic polynomial (Read's conjecture) by identifying them with mixed multiplicities of a hyperplane arrangement.

title: Lorentzian Polynomials
note: Lorentzian Polynomials. Defines Lorentzian polynomials generalizing volume polynomials and stable polynomials, proving ultra log-concavity for independent sets of matroids (Mason's conjecture).

title: Log-Concave Polynomials II: High-Dimensional Walks and an FPRAS for Counting Bases of a Matroid
note: Log-Concave Polynomials II: High-Dimensional Walks and an FPRAS for Counting Bases of a Matroid. Proves the bases-exchange walk on any matroid mixes rapidly via log-concavity of the basis generating polynomial.

title: Cluster Algebras I: Foundations
note: Cluster Algebras I: Foundations. Introduces cluster algebras defined by seeds and mutations, proving the Laurent phenomenon.

title: Cluster Algebras, Quiver Representations and Triangulated Categories
note: Cluster Algebras, Quiver Representations and Triangulated Categories. Survey of the categorification of cluster algebras via cluster categories, quiver representations with potential and Calabi–Yau triangulated categories.

title: Enumerative Tropical Algebraic Geometry in $\mathbb{R}^2$
note: Enumerative Tropical Algebraic Geometry in $\mathbb{R}^2$. Proves the correspondence theorem counting complex and real plane curves through points by tropical curves with multiplicities.

title: A Theory of Regularity Structures
note: A Theory of Regularity Structures. Introduces regularity structures and modelled distributions to solve singular SPDEs such as the dynamic $\Phi^4_3$ model and the parabolic Anderson model.

title: Solving the KPZ Equation
note: Solving the KPZ Equation. Constructs solutions of the KPZ equation via rough path theory and shows they coincide with the Cole–Hopf solutions.

title: Paracontrolled Distributions and Singular PDEs
note: Paracontrolled Distributions and Singular PDEs. Uses Bony's paraproducts to define and solve singular SPDEs via paracontrolled ansatz, an alternative to regularity structures.

title: Stein's Method on Wiener Chaos
note: Stein's Method on Wiener Chaos. Combines Stein's method with Malliavin calculus to obtain explicit bounds in normal approximation for functionals of Gaussian fields.

title: Gaussian Free Fields for Mathematicians
note: Gaussian Free Fields for Mathematicians. Expository construction of the discrete and continuum Gaussian free field, its conformal invariance and Markov property.

title: Scaling Limits of Loop-Erased Random Walks and Uniform Spanning Trees
note: Scaling Limits of Loop-Erased Random Walks and Uniform Spanning Trees. Introduces SLE$_\kappa$ and conjectures that loop-erased random walk converges to SLE$_2$.

title: Lectures on the Ising and Potts Models on the Hypercubic Lattice
note: Lectures on the Ising and Potts Models on the Hypercubic Lattice. Lecture notes on phase transitions of the Ising and Potts models through random-cluster representations, sharpness and continuity of the transition.

title: Continuity of the Phase Transition for Planar Random-Cluster and Potts Models with $1 \le q \le 4$
note: Continuity of the Phase Transition for Planar Random-Cluster and Potts Models with $1 \le q \le 4$. Proves the phase transition of planar FK percolation is continuous for $1 \le q \le 4$ via parafermionic observables and RSW estimates.

title: Explosive Percolation is Continuous
note: Explosive Percolation is Continuous. Shows Achlioptas processes have a continuous phase transition, refuting claims of discontinuous explosive percolation.

title: The Large Deviation Principle for the Erdős–Rényi Random Graph
note: The Large Deviation Principle for the Erdős–Rényi Random Graph. Proves a large deviation principle for $G(n,p)$ in the space of graphons with rate function given by relative entropy.

title: Nonlinear Large Deviations
note: Nonlinear Large Deviations. Develops a framework for large deviations of nonlinear functions of independent variables, applied to upper tails of subgraph counts.

title: Random Matrices: Universality of Local Eigenvalue Statistics
note: Random Matrices: Universality of Local Eigenvalue Statistics. Proves the four moment theorem, establishing universality of local eigenvalue statistics for Wigner matrices.

title: An Introduction to Matrix Concentration Inequalities
note: An Introduction to Matrix Concentration Inequalities. Monograph on matrix Chernoff, Bernstein and Hoeffding inequalities via Lieb's concavity theorem.

title: Finding Structure with Randomness: Probabilistic Algorithms for Constructing Approximate Matrix Decompositions
note: Finding Structure with Randomness: Probabilistic Algorithms for Constructing Approximate Matrix Decompositions. Randomized range finders and randomized SVD with error bounds, now a standard tool in numerical linear algebra.

title: Regret Analysis of Stochastic and Nonstochastic Multi-Armed Bandit Problems
note: Regret Analysis of Stochastic and Nonstochastic Multi-Armed Bandit Problems. Monograph on UCB, Exp3, linear and convex bandits with regret bounds for stochastic and adversarial settings.

title: Introduction to Multi-Armed Bandits
note: Introduction to Multi-Armed Bandits. Textbook on bandit algorithms: explore-first, UCB, Thompson sampling, adversarial and contextual bandits and bandits with knapsacks.

title: Convex Optimization: Algorithms and Complexity
note: Convex Optimization: Algorithms and Complexity. Monograph on oracle complexity of convex optimization: cutting planes, gradient descent, mirror descent, acceleration and stochastic methods.

title: Existence of Minimal Models for Varieties of Log General Type
note: Existence of Minimal Models for Varieties of Log General Type. Proves existence of log minimal models for klt pairs of log general type and finite generation of the canonical ring.

title: Anti-Pluricanonical Systems on Fano Varieties
note: Anti-Pluricanonical Systems on Fano Varieties. Proves effective boundedness of complements for Fano varieties, a key step toward BAB boundedness.

title: Kähler–Einstein Metrics on Fano Manifolds I: Approximation of Metrics with Cone Singularities
note: Kähler–Einstein Metrics on Fano Manifolds I: Approximation of Metrics with Cone Singularities. First of three papers proving that K-stable Fano manifolds admit Kähler–Einstein metrics, via cone-angle continuity.

title: K-Stability of Fano Varieties: An Algebro-Geometric Approach
note: K-Stability of Fano Varieties: An Algebro-Geometric Approach. Survey of the algebraic theory of K-stability: valuative criteria, $\delta$-invariants, and the construction of the K-moduli space of Fano varieties.

title: Semiorthogonal Decomposition for Algebraic Varieties
note: Semiorthogonal Decomposition for Algebraic Varieties. Studies semiorthogonal decompositions of $D^b(X)$ and proves the derived category determines varieties with ample or anti-ample canonical bundle.

title: Derived Categories of Coherent Sheaves and Triangulated Categories of Singularities
note: Derived Categories of Coherent Sheaves and Triangulated Categories of Singularities. Relates the singularity category $D^b(X)/\mathrm{Perf}(X)$ of a hypersurface to matrix factorizations and graded Landau–Ginzburg models.

title: Generators and Representability of Functors in Commutative and Noncommutative Geometry
note: Generators and Representability of Functors in Commutative and Noncommutative Geometry. Proves $D_{qc}(X)$ has a single compact generator for quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and that $D^b(X)$ is saturated for smooth proper $X$.

title: Stability Conditions on Triangulated Categories
note: Stability Conditions on Triangulated Categories. Defines stability conditions on a triangulated category and proves the space of stability conditions is a complex manifold.

title: The Spectrum of Prime Ideals in Tensor Triangulated Categories
note: The Spectrum of Prime Ideals in Tensor Triangulated Categories. Introduces the Balmer spectrum of a tensor triangulated category, recovering a scheme $X$ from $\mathrm{Perf}(X)$ and classifying thick tensor ideals.

title: The Decomposition Theorem, Perverse Sheaves and the Topology of Algebraic Maps
note: The Decomposition Theorem, Perverse Sheaves and the Topology of Algebraic Maps. Survey of perverse sheaves, the decomposition theorem, relative hard Lefschetz and their applications.

title: Parity Sheaves
note: Parity Sheaves. Introduces parity sheaves with modular coefficients on stratified varieties and uses them for modular geometric Satake.

title: Murphy's Law in Algebraic Geometry: Badly-Behaved Deformation Spaces
note: Murphy's Law in Algebraic Geometry: Badly-Behaved Deformation Spaces. Shows that many moduli spaces satisfy Murphy's law: every singularity type appears.

title: Good Moduli Spaces for Artin Stacks
note: Good Moduli Spaces for Artin Stacks. Introduces good moduli spaces for Artin stacks generalizing GIT quotients.

title: Existence of Moduli Spaces for Algebraic Stacks
note: Existence of Moduli Spaces for Algebraic Stacks. Gives intrinsic criteria ($\Theta$-reductivity and S-completeness) for an algebraic stack to admit a separated good moduli space.

title: On the Structure of Instability in Moduli Theory
note: On the Structure of Instability in Moduli Theory. Introduces $\Theta$-stratifications of algebraic stacks, generalizing the Harder–Narasimhan and Kempf–Ness stratifications.

title: The Intrinsic Normal Cone
note: The Intrinsic Normal Cone. Defines the intrinsic normal cone and perfect obstruction theories, constructing virtual fundamental classes.

title: Localization of Virtual Classes
note: Localization of Virtual Classes. Proves a virtual Atiyah–Bott localization formula for virtual fundamental classes with torus actions.

title: Enumeration of Rational Curves via Torus Actions
note: Enumeration of Rational Curves via Torus Actions. Introduces stable maps and computes Gromov–Witten invariants via torus localization.

title: Gromov–Witten Classes, Quantum Cohomology, and Enumerative Geometry
note: Gromov–Witten Classes, Quantum Cohomology, and Enumerative Geometry. Axiomatizes Gromov–Witten classes, defines quantum cohomology and derives Kontsevich's recursion.

title: Gromov–Witten Theory, Hurwitz Numbers, and Matrix Models
note: Gromov–Witten Theory, Hurwitz Numbers, and Matrix Models. Proves Witten's conjecture via Hurwitz numbers and the ELSV formula, relating GW theory to matrix models.

title: Curve Counting via Stable Pairs in the Derived Category
note: Curve Counting via Stable Pairs in the Derived Category. Introduces stable pairs invariants of Calabi–Yau threefolds and conjectures their equivalence with DT and GW invariants.

title: A Holomorphic Casson Invariant for Calabi–Yau 3-Folds, and Bundles on K3 Fibrations
note: A Holomorphic Casson Invariant for Calabi–Yau 3-Folds, and Bundles on K3 Fibrations. Defines Donaldson–Thomas invariants counting stable sheaves on Calabi–Yau threefolds via perfect obstruction theories.

title: Donaldson–Thomas Type Invariants via Microlocal Geometry
note: Donaldson–Thomas Type Invariants via Microlocal Geometry. Shows DT invariants are weighted Euler characteristics with respect to the Behrend function.

title: Stability Structures, Motivic Donaldson–Thomas Invariants and Cluster Transformations
note: Stability Structures, Motivic Donaldson–Thomas Invariants and Cluster Transformations. Proposes motivic DT invariants and the wall-crossing formula in terms of products of automorphisms of quantum tori.

title: Enumerative Invariants and Wall-Crossing Formulae in Abelian Categories
note: Enumerative Invariants and Wall-Crossing Formulae in Abelian Categories. Constructs a vertex algebra on the homology of moduli stacks and proves wall-crossing formulae for virtual classes via its Lie bracket.

title: Shifted Symplectic Structures
note: Shifted Symplectic Structures. Defines $n$-shifted symplectic structures on derived stacks; mapping stacks and derived critical loci carry them.

title: Homotopical Algebraic Geometry II: Geometric Stacks and Applications
note: Homotopical Algebraic Geometry II: Geometric Stacks and Applications. Develops derived and homotopical algebraic geometry via model categories of simplicial presheaves, geometric stacks and derived moduli.

title: Derived Algebraic Geometry
note: Derived Algebraic Geometry. Survey of derived algebraic geometry: derived schemes and stacks, derived moduli and shifted symplectic structures.

title: Deformation Quantization of Poisson Manifolds
note: Deformation Quantization of Poisson Manifolds. Proves every Poisson manifold admits a deformation quantization via the formality theorem.

title: Homological Algebra of Mirror Symmetry
note: Homological Algebra of Mirror Symmetry. ICM address proposing homological mirror symmetry: $D^b\mathrm{Coh}(X) \simeq D^\pi\mathrm{Fuk}(X^\vee)$.

title: A Beginner's Introduction to Fukaya Categories

note: Constructible Sheaves and the Fukaya Category. Proves the derived category of constructible sheaves on a manifold is equivalent to the Fukaya category of its cotangent bundle.

note: Sheaf Quantization of Hamiltonian Isotopies and Applications to Nondisplaceability Problems. Associates to a Hamiltonian isotopy a sheaf kernel whose microsupport is its graph.

title: Microlocal Condition for Non-Displaceability
note: Microlocal Condition for Non-Displaceability. Introduces microlocal sheaf methods to prove non-displaceability of Lagrangians.

note: Enhanced Six Operations and Base Change Theorem for Higher Artin Stacks. Constructs the six operations for $\ell$-adic sheaves on higher Artin stacks via $\infty$-categorical enhancements.

note: An Introduction to Six-Functor Formalisms. Lecture notes on six-functor formalisms in algebraic geometry with emphasis on motivic and étale examples.

title: Triangulated Categories of Mixed Motives
note: Triangulated Categories of Mixed Motives. Constructs Beilinson motives with rational coefficients and the six-functor formalism for them.

note: The Six Operations in Equivariant Motivic Homotopy Theory. Constructs the six operations for motivic homotopy theory on quotient stacks with tame group actions.

title: Norms in Motivic Homotopy Theory
note: Norms in Motivic Homotopy Theory. Constructs multiplicative norm functors for finite étale maps and defines normed motivic spectra.

title: Higher Topos Theory
note: Higher Topos Theory. Foundations of $\infty$-categories as quasicategories, presentable $\infty$-categories, $\infty$-topoi and descent.

title: On the Classification of Topological Field Theories
note: On the Classification of Topological Field Theories. Sketches the proof of the Baez–Dolan cobordism hypothesis via $(\infty,n)$-categories.

title: The 2-Category Theory of Quasi-Categories
note: The 2-Category Theory of Quasi-Categories. Develops quasi-category theory formally in the homotopy 2-category: adjunctions, limits and colimits.

title: A Survey of $(\infty, 1)$-Categories
note: A Survey of $(\infty, 1)$-Categories. Surveys models for $(\infty,1)$-categories and the Quillen equivalences between them.

title: Symmetric Spectra
note: Symmetric Spectra. Introduces symmetric spectra, a symmetric monoidal model category for the stable homotopy category.

title: On the Non-Existence of Elements of Kervaire Invariant One
note: On the Non-Existence of Elements of Kervaire Invariant One. Shows Kervaire invariant one elements do not exist beyond dimension 126 using $C_8$-equivariant homotopy theory.

title: Stable Homotopy Groups of Spheres: From Dimension 0 to 90
note: Stable Homotopy Groups of Spheres: From Dimension 0 to 90. Computes stable stems through dimension 90 via motivic homotopy theory and $\mathbb{C}$-motivic Adams spectral sequences.

note: The Triviality of the 61-Stem in the Stable Homotopy Groups of Spheres. Proves $\pi_{61}^s = 0$, showing $S^{61}$ has a unique smooth structure.

note: Purity in Chromatically Localized Algebraic K-Theory. Proves $T(n)$-local K-theory depends only on the $T(n-1) \oplus T(n)$-localization of the ring.

note: Descent and Vanishing in Chromatic Algebraic K-Theory via Group Actions. Proves Galois descent for $T(n)$-local K-theory and vanishing above height $n+1$.

title: Galois Extensions of Structured Ring Spectra
note: Galois Extensions of Structured Ring Spectra. Galois theory for commutative $S$-algebras, with $KO \to KU$ and $L_{K(n)}S \to E_n$ as examples.

title: On the Algebraic K-Theory of Higher Categories
note: On the Algebraic K-Theory of Higher Categories. Characterizes Waldhausen K-theory of $\infty$-categories as the universal additive functor.

title: Topological Cyclic Homology
note: Topological Cyclic Homology. Handbook chapter on $\mathrm{THH}$, $\mathrm{TC}$, cyclotomic spectra and computations for perfectoid rings.

title: K-Theory and Topological Cyclic Homology of Henselian Pairs
note: K-Theory and Topological Cyclic Homology of Henselian Pairs. Proves the fiber of $K \to \mathrm{TC}$ is invariant for henselian pairs.

title: On the Beilinson Fiber Square
note: On the Beilinson Fiber Square. Relates $K$, $\mathrm{TC}$, $\mathrm{HC}^-$ and $\mathrm{HP}$ rationally for $p$-adic rings.

title: Algebraic K-Theory and Descent for Blow-Ups
note: Algebraic K-Theory and Descent for Blow-Ups. Proves pro-cdh descent for K-theory and Weibel's conjecture on negative K-groups.

title: K-Theory and Localizing Invariants of Large Categories
note: K-Theory and Localizing Invariants of Large Categories. Extends localizing invariants to dualizable categories, computing continuous K-theory of sheaves on locally compact spaces.

title: Cellular $E_k$-Algebras
note: Cellular $E_k$-Algebras. Develops cell attachments for $E_k$-algebras and $E_k$-homology for homological stability.

title: Stable Moduli Spaces of High-Dimensional Manifolds
note: Stable Moduli Spaces of High-Dimensional Manifolds. Computes the stable homology of moduli spaces of $(2n)$-manifolds, generalizing Madsen–Weiss.

title: The Stable Moduli Space of Riemann Surfaces: Mumford's Conjecture
note: The Stable Moduli Space of Riemann Surfaces: Mumford's Conjecture. Proves Mumford's conjecture on the stable cohomology of mapping class groups.

title: FI-Modules and Stability for Representations of Symmetric Groups
note: FI-Modules and Stability for Representations of Symmetric Groups. Introduces FI-modules and representation stability, with applications to configuration spaces and congruence subgroups.

title: Factorization Homology of Topological Manifolds
note: Factorization Homology of Topological Manifolds. Develops factorization homology of $n$-manifolds with coefficients in $E_n$-algebras, with excision and nonabelian Poincaré duality.

title: Some Exotic Nontrivial Elements of the Rational Homotopy Groups of $\mathrm{Diff}(S^4)$
note: Some Exotic Nontrivial Elements of the Rational Homotopy Groups of $\mathrm{Diff}(S^4)$. Disproves the 4-dimensional Smale conjecture using graph-complex constructions.

title: Higher Operads, Higher Categories
note: Higher Operads, Higher Categories. Book on generalized operads and multicategories as a framework for weak $n$-categories.

title: Seven Sketches in Compositionality: An Invitation to Applied Category Theory
note: Seven Sketches in Compositionality: An Invitation to Applied Category Theory. Textbook introducing applied category theory through orders, databases, resource theories and operads.

title: Physics, Topology, Logic and Computation: A Rosetta Stone
note: Physics, Topology, Logic and Computation: A Rosetta Stone. Expository dictionary between physics, topology, logic and computation via closed symmetric monoidal categories.

title: Higher-Dimensional Algebra and Topological Quantum Field Theory
note: Higher-Dimensional Algebra and Topological Quantum Field Theory. States the cobordism, tangle and stabilization hypotheses for extended TQFTs in $n$-categories.

title: From Finite Sets to Feynman Diagrams
note: From Finite Sets to Feynman Diagrams. Categorifies combinatorics via groupoid cardinality and interprets Feynman diagrams via stuff types.

title: The Octonions
note: The Octonions. Survey of the octonions: normed division algebras, Clifford algebras, triality, and exceptional Lie groups.

title: The Unification of Mathematics via Topos Theory
note: The Unification of Mathematics via Topos Theory. Develops toposes as bridges: Morita-equivalent geometric theories translated via their classifying topos.

title: The Simplicial Model of Univalent Foundations
note: The Simplicial Model of Univalent Foundations. Constructs a model of Martin-Löf type theory with univalence in simplicial sets.

title: All $(\infty,1)$-Toposes Have Strict Univalent Universes
note: All $(\infty,1)$-Toposes Have Strict Univalent Universes. Proves every Grothendieck $(\infty,1)$-topos models homotopy type theory with strict univalent universes.

title: Homotopy Theoretic Models of Identity Types
note: Homotopy Theoretic Models of Identity Types. Interprets Martin-Löf identity types in model categories and weak factorization systems.

title: Functorial Data Migration
note: Functorial Data Migration. Models database schemas as categories and data migration as adjoint functors.

title: The Lean Mathematical Library
note: The Lean Mathematical Library. Describes the design of mathlib, the Lean mathematical library.

title: Planar Algebras, I
note: Planar Algebras, I. Introduces planar algebras as the axiomatization of the standard invariant of a subfactor.

title: Very Basic Noncommutative Geometry
note: Very Basic Noncommutative Geometry. Lecture notes on Gelfand–Naimark, Serre–Swan, noncommutative tori, K-theory and cyclic cohomology.

title: An Introduction to Noncommutative Geometry
note: An Introduction to Noncommutative Geometry. Lectures on spectral triples, the noncommutative torus, the Dixmier trace and the spectral action.

title: An Introduction to Noncommutative Spaces and Their Geometry
note: An Introduction to Noncommutative Spaces and Their Geometry. Lecture notes on noncommutative spaces, spectral triples and gauge theories.

title: Gravity and the Standard Model with Neutrino Mixing
note: Gravity and the Standard Model with Neutrino Mixing. Derives the Standard Model with neutrino mixing coupled to gravity from an almost commutative spectral triple.

title: Renormalization in Quantum Field Theory and the Riemann–Hilbert Problem I
note: Renormalization in Quantum Field Theory and the Riemann–Hilbert Problem I. Shows renormalization is a Birkhoff factorization of loops in the group of characters of the Hopf algebra of Feynman graphs.

title: Why Does Quantum Field Theory in Curved Spacetime Make Sense?
note: Why Does Quantum Field Theory in Curved Spacetime Make Sense?. Explains algebraic QFT in curved spacetime via the operator-algebraic formulation.

title: Fivebranes and Knots
note: Fivebranes and Knots. Proposes a gauge-theoretic interpretation of Khovanov homology via fivebranes.

title: Electric-Magnetic Duality, Monopole Condensation, and Confinement in N=2 Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Theory
note: Electric-Magnetic Duality, Monopole Condensation, and Confinement in N=2 Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Theory. Determines the low-energy effective action of $\mathcal{N}=2$ SU(2) Yang–Mills.

title: Monopoles and Four-Manifolds
note: Monopoles and Four-Manifolds. Introduces the Seiberg–Witten equations and invariants of four-manifolds.

title: Seiberg–Witten Prepotential from Instanton Counting
note: Seiberg–Witten Prepotential from Instanton Counting. Computes the Seiberg–Witten prepotential via equivariant localization in the $\Omega$-background.

title: Generalized Global Symmetries
note: Generalized Global Symmetries. Introduces higher-form symmetries acting on extended operators.

title: Reflection Positivity and Invertible Topological Phases
note: Reflection Positivity and Invertible Topological Phases. Classifies invertible topological phases via Madsen–Tillmann spectra and Anderson duals of bordism.

title: Loop Groups and Twisted K-Theory I
note: Loop Groups and Twisted K-Theory I. Identifies the Verlinde ring of a compact Lie group with twisted equivariant K-theory.

title: Quadratic Functions in Geometry, Topology, and M-Theory
note: Quadratic Functions in Geometry, Topology, and M-Theory. Develops differential cohomology with applications to the M-theory C-field.

title: Classical Chern–Simons Theory, Part 1
note: Classical Chern–Simons Theory, Part 1. Treats classical Chern–Simons theory as an extended field theory.

title: Periodic Table for Topological Insulators and Superconductors
note: Periodic Table for Topological Insulators and Superconductors. Classifies gapped free-fermion phases by the tenfold way via Bott periodicity.

title: Anyons in an Exactly Solved Model and Beyond
note: Anyons in an Exactly Solved Model and Beyond. Solves the honeycomb model and develops the theory of anyons via modular tensor categories.

title: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation by Anyons
note: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation by Anyons. Introduces the toric code and topological quantum computation with anyons.

title: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Prime Factorization and Discrete Logarithms on a Quantum Computer
note: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Prime Factorization and Discrete Logarithms on a Quantum Computer. Shor's algorithm via quantum period finding.

title: Good Quantum Error-Correcting Codes Exist
note: Good Quantum Error-Correcting Codes Exist. Constructs CSS codes from pairs of classical codes.

title: Stabilizer Codes and Quantum Error Correction
note: Stabilizer Codes and Quantum Error Correction. PhD thesis introducing the stabilizer formalism.

title: Quantum Computing in the NISQ Era and Beyond
note: Quantum Computing in the NISQ Era and Beyond. Assesses noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.

title: The Large N Limit of Superconformal Field Theories and Supergravity
note: The Large N Limit of Superconformal Field Theories and Supergravity. Proposes the AdS/CFT correspondence.

title: Anti de Sitter Space and Holography
note: Anti de Sitter Space and Holography. Makes the AdS/CFT dictionary precise.

title: Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT
note: Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT. Proposes the Ryu–Takayanagi formula for entanglement entropy.

title: Lectures on the Quantum Hall Effect
note: Lectures on the Quantum Hall Effect. Lecture notes on integer and fractional quantum Hall effects and Chern–Simons theory.

title: String Theory
note: String Theory. Cambridge lecture notes on bosonic string theory.

title: The Entropy Formula for the Ricci Flow and Its Geometric Applications
note: The Entropy Formula for the Ricci Flow and Its Geometric Applications. Introduces the $\mathcal{F}$- and $\mathcal{W}$-functionals and no local collapsing.

title: Ricci Flow with Surgery on Three-Manifolds
note: Ricci Flow with Surgery on Three-Manifolds. Constructs Ricci flow with surgery for the geometrization conjecture.

title: Structure Theory of Non-Collapsed Limits of Ricci Flows
note: Structure Theory of Non-Collapsed Limits of Ricci Flows. Develops a compactness and partial regularity theory for Ricci flows.

title: Generic Mean Curvature Flow I; Generic Singularities
note: Generic Mean Curvature Flow I; Generic Singularities. Shows the only entropy-stable self-shrinkers are generalized cylinders.

title: Finite Time Blowup for an Averaged Three-Dimensional Navier–Stokes Equation
note: Finite Time Blowup for an Averaged Three-Dimensional Navier–Stokes Equation. Constructs finite-time blowup for an averaged Navier–Stokes equation.

note: Stable Nearly Self-Similar Blowup of the 2D Boussinesq and 3D Euler Equations with Smooth Data. Computer-assisted proof of finite-time blowup for 3D axisymmetric Euler with boundary.

note: Finite-Time Singularity Formation for $C^{1,\alpha}$ Solutions to the Incompressible Euler Equations on $\mathbb{R}^3$. Constructs finite-time singularities for 3D Euler with $C^{1,\alpha}$ velocity.

note: An Extension Problem Related to the Fractional Laplacian. Realizes $(-\Delta)^s$ as a Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a degenerate elliptic extension.

title: Attention Is All You Need
note: Attention Is All You Need. Introduces the Transformer based on multi-head self-attention.

note: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding. Pretrains bidirectional Transformer encoders with masked language modeling.

note: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners. GPT-3, a 175B-parameter language model with strong in-context learning.

note: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models. Power-law scaling of language model loss with parameters, data and compute.

note: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models. Chinchilla: scale parameters and tokens equally.

note: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback. InstructGPT: RLHF for instruction following.

note: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback. Trains harmless assistants from AI feedback guided by a constitution.

note: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models. Prompting with intermediate reasoning steps improves multi-step reasoning.

note: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models. Interleaves reasoning traces with tool actions for LLM agents.

note: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools. Self-supervised learning of API calls.

note: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?. Benchmark of real GitHub issues for software engineering agents.

note: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks. Combines a dense retriever with a seq2seq generator (RAG).

note: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT. Late-interaction retrieval with per-token embeddings.

note: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines. Programming model that compiles LM pipelines by optimizing prompts.

note: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena. Studies strong LLMs as evaluators.

note: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention. vLLM: paged KV-cache for LLM serving.

note: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs. Frontend language and runtime with RadixAttention.

note: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness. IO-aware tiled exact attention.

note: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models. Fine-tunes with trainable low-rank updates.

note: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model. Optimizes preferences with a classification loss instead of RLHF.

note: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces. Selective state-space models with linear-time scaling.

note: In-context Learning and Induction Heads. Evidence that induction heads drive in-context learning.

note: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization. Adaptive moment estimation for stochastic gradient optimization.

note: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. Residual networks with identity shortcuts.

note: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes. Variational autoencoders via the reparameterization trick.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
note: Generative Adversarial Networks. Adversarial training of generator and discriminator.

note: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models. Diffusion models trained by denoising score matching.

note: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations. Unifies score-based and diffusion models through forward and reverse-time SDEs.

note: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning. Deep Q-networks from pixels.

note: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms. Clipped surrogate objective for policy gradient reinforcement learning.

note: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with a General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm. AlphaZero via self-play and Monte Carlo tree search.

note: Neural Tangent Kernel: Convergence and Generalization in Neural Networks. Infinite-width networks train as kernel regression with the NTK.

note: Reconciling Modern Machine Learning Practice and the Bias-Variance Trade-Off. Describes double descent.

note: Understanding Deep Learning Requires Rethinking Generalization. Deep networks fit random labels, challenging classical generalization theory.

note: Geometric Deep Learning: Grids, Groups, Graphs, Geodesics, and Gauges. Unifies deep learning architectures by symmetry and invariance.

note: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks. Graph convolutional networks from spectral graph convolutions.

note: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations. Continuous-depth networks with adjoint backpropagation.
